segments.text: You need to use a hot plate near another piece of equipment.
segments.zh: 你需要在另一台设备旁边使用电热板。

segments.text: There are no outlets available near it, so you use an extension cord and plug it into
segments.zh: 附近没有可用的插座，所以你用了一根延长线，把它插到

segments.text: a power cord on the other side of the laboratory in front of the door.
segments.zh: 实验室另一侧、门前的一个电源插座上。

segments.text: You leave the unlabeled solution stirring for a short period of time.
segments.zh: 你让这瓶没有标签的溶液搅拌一小段时间，然后离开了。

segments.text: Before you return to unplug the hot plate, another laboratory staff member trips over
segments.zh: 在你回来拔掉电热板的插头之前，另一名实验室工作人员被

segments.text: the cord and burns their hand on the hot plate.
segments.zh: 电线绊倒，手被电热板烫伤了。

segments.text: What were the circumstances leading to this incident, and how could it have been avoided?
segments.zh: 导致这起事故的情况有哪些？本来可以怎样避免？
